title: Love Sting
author: Rick Mohr
problems: Row 7 "star left 4 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 8 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
The progression after row 8 "partners swing" doesn't work out: Couple 2 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 1 "down the hall and right hand high, left hand low +" can't start from where the dancers are: Down the hall needs two dancers on each side to form a line of four.
choices: A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).

figures.text: down the hall and right hand high, left hand low +
up the hall and bend into a ring
right diagonal robins chain to shadow
